arStrings.szText: {c_important}Lacerate{/c} gains {c_number}[SF_28]{/c} additional strikes and deals its total damage {c_number}[SF_29*100|%|]{/c} faster.
{c_important}Lacerate{/c} explodes when striking a Poisoned target, dealing {c_number}[SF_35*100|%|]{/c} of the total Poisoning damage to them.

{c_important}Lacerate{/c} grants a {c_number}[SF_30*100|x%|]{/c} Movement Speed bonus and Lesser Enemies are pulled along with you. {c_important}Lacerate's{/c} damage is also increased by {c_number}[SF_34*100|x%|]{/c}.
When {c_important}Lacerate{/c} directly strikes the same enemy, that enemy takes {c_number}[SF_40*100|x%|]{/c} stacking bonus damage from {c_important}Lacerate{/c}.
{c_important}Lacerate{/c} gains a {c_number}[SF_22*100|x%|]{/c} bonus damage bonus each time it strikes a different enemy up to a maximum of {c_number}[SF_23*100|%|]{/c}.
{c_important}Lacerate{/c} grants {c_number}{SF_42}{/c} Stacks of {c_important}{u}Ferocity{/u}{/c} each second while active.
